locations.label: Power switch
locations.description: Open either side from the mainframe at Spawn and work toward the rear central courtyard. Activate the power switch beside the original Box location; the bridge lowers and the perk machines and electric traps become available. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Pack-a-Punch / mainframe
locations.description: Every successful link lowers the barrier around the Pack-a-Punch machine. After all three, upgrade a gun at Spawn for 5,000 points. Linked teleporters can return you to the mainframe for 1,500 points, but check the pad is clear before arriving. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Laboratory teleporter
locations.description: Find Teleporter A through Animal Testing on the left route, B through the Thompson/Automobile Garage route on the right, and C at the back by the catwalk/Bowie Knife area. At each teleporter, hold interact to start a link, then reach the mainframe in Spawn and interact within 30 seconds. A teammate may finish the link for you. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
